_comment: Editorial content for MCBIM. Every fact is attributable — see sourceNote. MCBIM is an asset manager — a fund-management company, not an operating industrial business, and it is distinct from the funds it manages. No image is attached.
description: MCB Investment Management Limited, which trades as MCB Funds, was established in 2000 and manages open-end mutual funds, voluntary pension schemes and separately managed accounts. The company reports more than 242,000 customers and net assets of over PKR 553 billion across its open-end schemes, pension funds and managed accounts as of 31 December 2025, and holds a PACRA AM1 asset manager rating. It also runs iSAVE, an online savings and investment platform with a minimum investment of Rs 500.
headOffice: 2nd Floor, Adamjee House, I.I. Chundrigar Road, Karachi, Pakistan
